protocol.policy_selection: Maximize the smaller mean food score of NanoJev and Jev; break ties by their mean food score, then survival rate, then greedy. Apply one selected policy to all compared systems.
protocol.case_selection: Outcome-selected highlight: require NanoJev and Jev to survive the complete 256-step horizon while the original Qwen run becomes trapped; among eligible cases prefer the largest minimum NanoJev/Jev food score, then their mean food score.
protocol.maze_selection: Fixed existing 50x50 OOD case; deterministic model-guided local-edge exploration, not stochastic action sampling.
protocol.common_snake_code: Filter immediate collisions; retain actions on shortest static safe food paths when available; model ranks remaining ties; forced moves use code.
protocol.original_case_selection: Among shared cases in the selected policy, maximize minimum NanoJev/Jev food score, then their mean food score, then the food-score gap above the native baseline. Preserve complete recorded episodes and label the result as a selected showcase, not a cohort average.

selection_revision.timing: After examining greedy outcomes; this is an editorial showcase selection, not a preregistered model-quality estimate.
selection_revision.reason: The user requested the most interesting complete game example and previously specified successful NanoJev/Jev runs with a failing untuned baseline. All eight-case controller results remain in the comparison summary.

model.probability_semantics: Original LM next-token probabilities conditional on the offered A-D tokens; zero output decoding

metric_scope.food: Final food score, all eight cases retained including trapped outcomes.
metric_scope.survival: Fraction reaching the complete 256-step horizon; full-board wins are counted separately.
metric_scope.model_role: The common code planner filters collisions and ranks static paths to visible food. Models select only among residual candidates. Forced moves are not model decisions.
metric_scope.sampling: One fixed seed per episode and one sampled trajectory per model; no repeated-seed uncertainty estimate.
metric_scope.case_selection: The displayed case was revised after observing outcomes. Its performance is not a cohort average.

selected_controller.name: greedy
selected_controller.rule: Maximize the smaller mean food score of NanoJev and Jev; break ties by their mean food score, then survival rate, then greedy. Apply one selected policy to all compared systems.
selected_controller.survival_tie_break_definition: Mean of NanoJev and Jev survival-or-win rates; no full-board wins occur here, and the primary criterion already breaks the tie.
selected_controller.reason: The primary criterion is 21.0 for greedy versus 20.75 for sample. This selects one common controller, not an individually best controller for every model.
selected_controller.individual_model_caveat: Jev mean food increases from 22.75 with greedy to 25.0 with sample. Untuned Qwen means are 23.75 for both. NanoJev means are 21.0 and 20.75.
